title: Iran's winter gas deficit threatens gas-based DRI steel output
dek: A winter gas deficit in Iran threatens output at its gas-based DRI steel plants, according to Shanghai Metals Market.
summary: Shanghai Metals Market reports that Iran's winter gas deficit threatens output of gas-based direct reduced iron (DRI) steel. Only the headline is available; the publisher's material gives no figures on the size of the shortfall, affected plants or expected production losses.
keyFacts: Iran faces a winter gas deficit, per the headline
The deficit threatens gas-based DRI steel output
whyItMatters: Iran is heavily reliant on gas-based DRI for steelmaking, so gas curtailments could reduce DRI and steel output. This may affect regional availability of semi-finished steel and DRI.
implications: Buyers sourcing billets or DRI from Iran may wish to watch for supply disruptions over the winter. Competing regional suppliers could find openings if Iranian output falls, though the excerpt does not quantify any impact.
